notes.title: Character Prototype: Bruiser + Patch Notes
notes.notes:
This patch introduces a new character in the Bruiser (the name is a placeholder).
The Bruiser is designed with a lower barrier of entry, making them a good introduction to players who are not used to playing melee characters. The Bruiser has an affinity for AoE, crowd control and will go on a rampage if the conditions are met.

Additionally, menus and level travel visuals are being revamped.
